integrity: Standalone proof and executable verification supplied; 10128 rational identities and 250 independent ODE integrations checked. Computational checks are not a substitute for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The all-time formula does not cover general bipartite weights, nonreciprocal bias, the discrete expected recursion, or the original stochastic opinion process. Priority comparison is best-knowledge only.
scientific_scope: Reciprocal partwise bias on connected weighted loopless bipartite social networks; exact equilibria for all such networks and explicit continuous-time trajectories for unweighted complete bipartite graphs.
title: Reciprocal-bias bipartite social pressure: the full equilibrium curve and an exact complete-bipartite flow
